characteristic_function.condition: chi = 1 if phi(x) < 0 and chi = 0 if phi(x) >= 0

expressions.name: k
expressions.formula: k(x) = k_0 if phi(x) < 0, k_0/1000 if phi(x) >= 0

expressions.name: E
expressions.formula: E(x) = E_0 if phi(x) < 0, E_0/1000 if phi(x) >= 0

expressions.name: alpha_T_x
expressions.formula: alpha_T(x) = alpha_T if phi(x) < 0, alpha_T/1000 if phi(x) >= 0

expressions.name: epsilon
expressions.formula: varepsilon(u) = (nabla u + nabla u^T)/2

expressions.name: epsilon_delta_u
expressions.formula: varepsilon(delta u) = (nabla delta u + nabla delta u^T)/2

expressions.name: lambda
expressions.formula: lambda = - nu E / ((nu + 1)(2 nu - 1))

expressions.name: epsilon_e
expressions.formula: varepsilon_e(T,u) = - I alpha_T T + varepsilon(u)

expressions.name: J
expressions.formula: J(u) = int_D ell chi dx + int_{Gamma_D} beta (e_x . u)^2 ds_x - int_{Gamma_N} gamma (e_y . u) ds_x

expressions.name: dJ_du
expressions.formula: dJ = - int_{Gamma_N} gamma (e_y . delta u) ds_x + int_{Gamma_D} 2 beta (e_x . u)^2 (e_x . delta u) (e_x . u)^{-1} ds_x

expressions.name: d_epsilon_e_dT
expressions.formula: d_epsilon_e(delta T) = - I alpha_T delta T

expressions.name: d_epsilon_e_du
expressions.formula: d_epsilon_e(delta u) = varepsilon(delta u)

expressions.name: dV_epsilon_delta_u
expressions.formula: V(epsilon) = ((nabla delta u . F^{-1}) + (nabla delta u . F^{-1})^T)/2

expressions.name: dV_epsilon_u
expressions.formula: V(varepsilon) = ((nabla u . F^{-1}) + (nabla u . F^{-1})^T)/2

expressions.name: dV_epsilon_e
expressions.formula: V(epsilon_e) = - I alpha_T T + V(varepsilon)

expressions.name: dV_J
expressions.formula: V(J) = int_D ell chi det F(t) dx + int_{Gamma_D} beta det F(t) sqrt((n . F^{-1}) . (n . F^{-1})) (e_x . u)^2 ds_x - int_{Gamma_N} gamma det F(t) sqrt((n . F^{-1}) . (n . F^{-1})) (e_y . u) ds_x

expressions.name: dt_J
expressions.formula: dt J = int_D ell chi div V dx - (int_{Gamma_N} gamma div V (e_y . u) ds_x - int_{Gamma_N} gamma (n . (n . nabla V)) (e_y . u) ds_x) + int_{Gamma_D} beta div V (e_x . u)^2 ds_x - int_{Gamma_D} beta (n . (n . nabla V)) (e_x . u)^2 ds_x

expressions.name: dt_epsilon_u
expressions.formula: dt varepsilon(V,u) = - ((nabla u . nabla V) + (nabla u . nabla V)^T)/2

expressions.name: dt_epsilon_u_tilde
expressions.formula: dt varepsilon(u_tilde,V) = - ((nabla u_tilde . nabla V) + (nabla u_tilde . nabla V)^T)/2

expressions.name: dt_epsilon_e_u
expressions.formula: dt epsilon_e(V,u) = dt varepsilon(V,u)

expressions.name: perturbation_map
expressions.formula: x = T_t(X) = X + t V(X)

expressions.name: perturbed_lagrangian_G
expressions.formula: G(t,[T,u]^L,[delta T,delta u]^L) = int_D k det F(t) ((nabla T . F^{-1}(t)) . (nabla delta T . F^{-1}(t))) dx + V(J) + int_{Gamma_D} beta det F(t) sqrt((n . F^{-1}(t)) . (n . F^{-1}(t))) (u . delta u) ds_x + int_{Gamma_N} q det F(t) sqrt((n . F^{-1}(t)) . (n . F^{-1}(t))) (e_y . delta u) ds_x + int_D det F(t) ((I lambda tr(V(epsilon_e)) + 2 mu V(epsilon_e)) : V(epsilon)^T) dx + int_D rho g chi det F(t) (e_y . delta u) dx

lagrangian.objective: J(\mathbf u) = \int_D \ell \raisebox{\depth}{$\chi$} \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_D} \beta (\mathbf e_x \cdot \mathbf u)^2 \,ds_x - \int_{\Gamma_N} \gamma (\mathbf e_y \cdot \mathbf u) \,ds_x

state_equation.description: Linear two-field state [T, u]: thermal equation for all delta_T in V_delta_T and elasticity equation for all delta_u in V_delta_u
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: thermal: \int_D k (\nabla T \cdot \nabla \delta T)\,dx ; elasticity: \int_{\Gamma_D} \beta (\mathbf u \cdot \delta\mathbf u)\,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_N} q (\mathbf e_y \cdot \delta\mathbf u)\,ds_x + \int_D \rho g \raisebox{\depth}{$\chi$} (\mathbf e_y \cdot \delta\mathbf u)\,dx + \int_D ((\mathbf I \lambda \operatorname{tr}(\pmb\varepsilon_e(T,\mathbf u)) + 2 \mu \pmb\varepsilon_e(T,\mathbf u)) : \pmb\varepsilon(\delta\mathbf u)^\top)\,dx

adjoint_equation.description: Adjoint state [T_tilde, u_tilde] in V_delta_T x V_delta_u
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: thermal: \int_D k (\nabla \delta T \cdot \nabla \tilde T)\,dx + \int_D ((\mathbf I \lambda \operatorname{tr}(\partial_{(T,\delta T)} \pmb\varepsilon_e(\delta T)) + 2 \mu \partial_{(T,\delta T)} \pmb\varepsilon_e(\delta T)) : \pmb\varepsilon(\tilde{\mathbf u})^\top)\,dx ; elasticity: \partial_{(\mathbf u,\delta\mathbf u)} J(\delta\mathbf u,\mathbf u) + \int_{\Gamma_D} \beta (\delta\mathbf u \cdot \tilde{\mathbf u})\,ds_x + \int_D ((\mathbf I \lambda \operatorname{tr}(\partial_{(\mathbf u,\delta\mathbf u)} \pmb\varepsilon_e(\delta\mathbf u)) + 2 \mu \partial_{(\mathbf u,\delta\mathbf u)} \pmb\varepsilon_e(\delta\mathbf u)) : \pmb\varepsilon(\tilde{\mathbf u})^\top)\,dx

designed.domain_description: Rectangular domain D = [0,4] x [0,1] (a 4:1 strip) as produced by square(4*n, n, [4*x, y])

boundaries.name: Gamma_D
boundaries.definition: left edge of D: x = 0, 0 <= y <= 1
boundaries.rationale: The beta(u.delta u) spring/penalty term makes this the elastic support; material at the anchor is frozen.

boundaries.name: Gamma_N
boundaries.definition: right edge of D: x = 4, 0 <= y <= 1
boundaries.rationale: Carries the traction q e_y; the loaded edge has a prescribed position and stays frozen.

boundaries.name: Gamma_1
boundaries.definition: bottom edge of D: y = 0, 0 <= x <= 4
boundaries.rationale: Thermal Dirichlet edge (T = -30) and the free lower surface along which the level set evolves.

boundaries.name: Gamma_3
boundaries.definition: top edge of D: y = 1, 0 <= x <= 4
boundaries.rationale: Thermal Dirichlet edge (T = -30) and the free upper surface along which the level set evolves.

fields.name: T
fields.rationale: P2 scalar temperature, Dirichlet -30 on the bottom (1) and top (3) edges as stated in V_T.

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: P2 vector displacement; V_u = P2 carries no Dirichlet condition.

fields.name: T_tilde
fields.rationale: Adjoint temperature in V_delta_T, zero on the same Dirichlet edges.

fields.name: u_tilde
fields.rationale: Adjoint displacement in V_delta_u = P2, no Dirichlet condition.

lagrangian.objective_description: Material cost plus a beta-weighted horizontal displacement cost on the support edge Gamma_D minus a gamma-weighted vertical displacement on the loaded edge Gamma_N

objective_terms.rationale: Gamma_D resolves to mesh label 4 (left edge).
Gamma_N resolves to mesh label 2 (right edge).

state_equation.description: Linear two-field state [T,u]: thermal equation for all delta_T in V_delta_T and elasticity equation for all delta_u in V_delta_u; Dirichlet T = -30 on labels 1 and 3 is carried by the field declaration
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: thermal over D: \int_D k (\nabla T \cdot \nabla \delta T)\,dx ; elasticity: \int_{4} \beta (\mathbf u \cdot \delta\mathbf u)\,ds_x + \int_{2} q (\mathbf e_y \cdot \delta\mathbf u)\,ds_x + \int_D \rho g \raisebox{\depth}{$\chi$} (\mathbf e_y \cdot \delta\mathbf u)\,dx + \int_D ((\mathbf I \lambda \operatorname{tr}(\pmb\varepsilon_e(T,\mathbf u)) + 2 \mu \pmb\varepsilon_e(T,\mathbf u)) : \pmb\varepsilon(\delta\mathbf u)^\top)\,dx
state_equation.rationale: Source weak forms transcribed with the boundary labels resolved (Gamma_D -> 4, Gamma_N -> 2); no penalty term is needed since the only Dirichlet datum is the single value -30.

adjoint_equation.description: Adjoint state [T_tilde,u_tilde] in V_delta_T x V_delta_u, with T_tilde = 0 on labels 1 and 3 carried by the field declaration
adjoint_equation.weak_form_lhs: thermal: \int_D k (\nabla \delta T \cdot \nabla \tilde T)\,dx + \int_D ((\mathbf I \lambda \operatorname{tr}(\partial_{(T,\delta T)} \pmb\varepsilon_e(\delta T)) + 2 \mu \partial_{(T,\delta T)} \pmb\varepsilon_e(\delta T)) : \pmb\varepsilon(\tilde{\mathbf u})^\top)\,dx ; elasticity: \partial_{(\mathbf u,\delta\mathbf u)} J(\delta\mathbf u,\mathbf u) + \int_{4} \beta (\delta\mathbf u \cdot \tilde{\mathbf u})\,ds_x + \int_D ((\mathbf I \lambda \operatorname{tr}(\partial_{(\mathbf u,\delta\mathbf u)} \pmb\varepsilon_e(\delta\mathbf u)) + 2 \mu \partial_{(\mathbf u,\delta\mathbf u)} \pmb\varepsilon_e(\delta\mathbf u)) : \pmb\varepsilon(\tilde{\mathbf u})^\top)\,dx
adjoint_equation.rationale: Source adjoint system with Gamma_D resolved to label 4.

optimization_config.hmin_rationale: About a quarter of the 0.04 element size so thin members stay resolved.
optimization_config.hmax_rationale: Comparable to the 0.04 background mesh, so the 0.3-thick trunk stays several elements wide.
optimization_config.diffusion_rationale: Small level-set diffusion regularises the interface over the 0.05 element scale.
optimization_config.v0_rationale: Unit velocity scale, small compared with the 4-unit length of the beam.
optimization_config.phi_rationale: I-beam-type seed: full-height flanges covering the frozen support (x=0) and loaded (x=4) edges joined by a central web (solid fraction about 0.44, symmetric about y=0.5).
optimization_config.boundary_labels_rationale: The free top and bottom surfaces where the level set may move material.
optimization_config.fixed_labels_rationale: Loaded right edge and spring-supported left edge must keep material from iteration 0.
